decoding.temperature: not exposed; adaptive thinking with output_config.effort
decoding.why_not_max: At effort=max the self_refine rewrite (which carries the draft and the critique in context) spends the entire budget reasoning and emits no prose: stop_reason=max_tokens, content=['thinking'], no text. 15/15 self_refine cells came back empty at 16k and 9/15 still truncated at 32k, at a mean of 38,533 output tokens per cell. Anthropic bills thinking against max_tokens. effort=high is the level Gemini 3.1 Pro ran at (thinking_level=high).

normalization.why: generation hygiene: strip scaffolding before scoring, uniform across legs

generation.driver: bench/run_batch.py (Anthropic Message Batches API, 50% of list price)
generation.why_32k: 2x the shared 16k. On Anthropic, max_tokens caps thinking and text together, whereas Gemini does not return its thoughts and GLM/Kimi stream thinking into output but stay far under the cap. A flat 16k gives Opus less room to write than every other leg; 32k restores a comparable text budget, not a comparable raw cap.
generation.waves: 3 sequential batches (single-shot modes + self_refine drafts; critiques; rewrites)

duration: ~3h across 3 batch waves (interrupted once by an account spend cap, checkpoint-resumed)
cost_usd: $47.36 from per-cell telemetry at the batched rate ($2.50/$12.50 per Mtok, half the $5/$25 list): 3,539,934 input, 3,080,878 output tokens (thinking is included in output_tokens).
excluded: none: 3000/3000 cells, zero empty, truncated or refused.
provenance: Generated via the Anthropic Message Batches API against pinned prompts; normalized and scored by the same paired script as every other leg.
